column1: Γ_A ≠ Γ_B as one-step maps: 48/512 states differ.
Despite this, their induced normal-form maps Γ_A* and Γ_B* are extensionally identical on all 512 states.
Therefore NX-001B supports canonicality at the level of closure semantics for this finite realization.
It does NOT prove unique primitive canonicality, because both realizations still implement the same 3-element relation-closure semantics.
It also does not establish universal equivalence across other state spaces, operator definitions, or domains.
